history.prompt: Extreme close-up macro photograph, 100mm macro lens. A heavy, weathered steel industrial shipping crate latch, showing deep rust, scratches, and physical wear. Attached to the heavy metal is a sleek, pristine digital sensor with a tiny glowing blue indicator light. Shallow depth of field, one razor-sharp focal plane on the sensor and the rusted steel immediately behind it. Soft directional daylight, visible surface texture and dust, hero object off-centre on the thirds with the background falling away into a soft, out-of-focus industrial grey. Quiet confidence, editorial restraint.

Telephoto compression, 200mm long-lens view of industrial infrastructure. Stacked overlapping layers of intermodal shipping containers receding into atmospheric haze. A massive overflow freight yard, towering walls of corrugated steel physical inventory buffers. Flat compressed perspective, overcast light, cool desaturated palette with muted rust and steel-blue tones. Generous editorial negative space, quiet confidence, sophisticated color palette, strictly no people in the foreground.
